subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Orthogonal Arrays
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Orthogonal Arrays.

hook.text: A math trick from the 1940s lets you test dozens of variable combinations in a fraction of the test cases.

buildup.text: Orthogonal arrays are pre-computed tables that ensure balanced coverage of all variable combinations.

discovery.text: Each row is a test case. The array guarantees every pair (or triple) of values is covered equally.

twist.text: You can't customize orthogonal arrays easily. If your inputs don't fit a standard array, you need a different approach.

climax.text: Taguchi popularized orthogonal arrays in manufacturing. Software testing adopted them decades later.
